          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if docker exec $(docker ps -q --filter ancestor=ipfs/kubo:v0.40.0) ipfs id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Kubo ready with CORS configured"
              break
            fi
            sleep 2
          done

      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/web-e2e exec playwright install chromium --with-deps

      - name: Install mock-ipns-routing dependencies
        run: |
          cd tools/mock-ipns-routing
          npm install
          npm run build

      - name: Build packages (excluding desktop)
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api-client build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk-core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/web build
        env:
          VITE_WEB3AUTH_CLIENT_ID: ${{ vars.VITE_WEB3AUTH_CLIENT_ID }}
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000

      - name: Create .env files for Web E2E
        run: |
          # Web app .env (for Vite dev server)
          echo "VITE_WEB3AUTH_CLIENT_ID=${{ vars.VITE_WEB3AUTH_CLIENT_ID }}" > apps/web/.env
          echo "VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000" >> apps/web/.env
          # API .env (for NestJS)
          echo "NODE_ENV=test" > apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_HOST=localhost" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_PORT=5432" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_USERNAME=postgres" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_PASSWORD=postgres" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "JWT_SECRET=e2e-test-jwt-secret-key-for-ci" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "IPFS_PROVIDER=local" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "REDIS_HOST=localhost" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "REDIS_PORT=6379" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Run Web E2E tests
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/web-e2e test
        env:
          CI: true
          # Database configuration
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          # IPFS configuration
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          # API configuration
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-test-jwt-secret-key-for-ci
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173
          # IPNS delegated routing (mock service)
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          # Redis for BullMQ job scheduling
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          # Web app configuration (needed for Web3Auth initialization)
          VITE_WEB3AUTH_CLIENT_ID: ${{ vars.VITE_WEB3AUTH_CLIENT_ID }}
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          # Test-login endpoint (bypasses Core Kit, uses deterministic keypair)
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          SDK_E2E_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          # Web3Auth test credentials (fallback if TEST_LOGIN_SECRET not set)
          WEB3AUTH_TEST_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.WEB3AUTH_TEST_EMAIL }}
          WEB3AUTH_TEST_OTP: ${{ secrets.WEB3AUTH_TEST_OTP }}

      - name: Upload Playwright report on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: |
            tests/web-e2e/playwright-report/
            tests/web-e2e/test-results/
          retention-days: 7

  retrigger-release-gate:
    name: Re-trigger Release Gate
    needs: web-e2e
    if: always() && github.event_name == 'push'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: write
      pull-requests: read
    steps:
      - name: Re-run release gate on open release-please PR
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Find any open release-please PR
          PR_BRANCH=$(gh pr list --repo "${{ github.repository }}" \
            --search "head:release-please" --state open --limit 1 \
            --json headRefName --jq '.[0].headRefName // empty')

          if [ -z "$PR_BRANCH" ]; then
            echo "No open release-please PR — nothing to re-trigger"
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "Found open release-please PR on branch: ${PR_BRANCH}"

          # Find the most recent release gate run for this branch
          RUN_ID=$(gh run list --repo "${{ github.repository }}" \
            --workflow=release-gate.yml --branch="${PR_BRANCH}" \
            --limit 1 --json databaseId,status \
            --jq '.[0].databaseId // empty')

          if [ -z "$RUN_ID" ]; then
            echo "No release gate run found for ${PR_BRANCH} — nothing to re-trigger"
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "Re-running release gate (run ${RUN_ID}) so it verifies E2E against current main"
          gh run rerun "${RUN_ID}" --repo "${{ github.repository }}"

content.text:
Makes sense. The desktop-e2e pattern is clean — `dorny/paths-filter` for change detection, then skip the expensive job if nothing relevant changed. Here's the path list that would cover web E2E:

| Path | Reason |
|------|--------|
| `apps/web/**` | Web app itself |
| `apps/api/**` | API (backend for all E2E tests) |
| `packages/crypto/**` | Crypto lib used by web + API |
| `packages/core/**` | Core lib used by web |
| `packages/api-client/**` | Generated API client |
| `packages/sdk/**` | SDK (used by E2E tests directly) |
| `packages/sdk-core/**` | SDK core |
| `tests/web-e2e/**` | The tests themselves |
| `.github/workflows/e2e.yml` | Workflow changes |

One thing to consider: the `retrigger-release-gate` job should still run even when E2E is skipped (since it needs to re-trigger the gate regardless). But that's fine — it only needs the change detection output, not the E2E result.

Want me to implement this using the same `dorny/paths-filter` + conditional pattern as desktop-e2e?

message.content: Yes I think this is a great pattern to follow. while we are at it, would it possibly make sense to use once common `detect changes` job driving whether the `web-e2e` and `desktop-e2e` are needed

content.text:
Good idea. Right now change detection is duplicated — desktop-e2e has its own `dorny/paths-filter`, and we'd be adding another to e2e.yml. A single orchestrator is cleaner.

The approach:

1. **New `ci-e2e.yml`** — triggers on push to main, runs one `detect-changes` job with both web and desktop patterns, conditionally calls each E2E workflow via `workflow_call`, and owns the `retrigger-release-gate` job
2. **`e2e.yml` and `desktop-e2e.yml`** — remove `push` trigger, keep `workflow_call` + `workflow_dispatch` (so manual runs and release gate calls still work)
3. **Release gate** — update polling from `--workflow=e2e.yml` to `--workflow=ci-e2e.yml`

One thing to note: `dorny/paths-filter` uses `github.event.before` which is only available on `push` events — but since the orchestrator is the one triggered by push, that context flows through correctly.

Let me check the desktop-e2e workflow fully to make sure I capture all its patterns and the conditional logic.

file.content:
name: Desktop E2E Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: 'Git ref to checkout (tag, branch, or SHA)'
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    # Only run change detection for push events (skip for workflow_dispatch and workflow_call)
    if: github.event_name == 'push'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          base: ${{ github.event.before }}
          filters: |
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'crates/**'
              - 'Cargo.toml'
              - 'Cargo.lock'
              - 'tests/vectors/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/desktop-e2e.yml'

  desktop-e2e:
    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})
    needs: [changes]
    if: >-
      always() && !cancelled() &&
      (
        github.event_name != 'push' ||
        needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
      )
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: macos
            os: macos-latest
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop.exe
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}

      # --- Install FUSE driver (needed for both build and test) ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install system dependencies (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential
          sudo modprobe fuse || true

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow
          # Verify WinFsp installed and add bin to PATH for DLL discovery
          $winfspDir = (Get-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\WinFsp" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).InstallDir
          if ($winfspDir) {
            Write-Host "WinFsp installed at: $winfspDir"
            $binDir = Join-Path $winfspDir "bin"
            Write-Host "Adding to PATH: $binDir"
            echo "$binDir" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Encoding utf8 -Append
          } else {
            Write-Host "WARNING: WinFsp registry key not found after install"
          }

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm (needed for frontend build before cargo) ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # --- Build desktop frontend (Tauri embeds from frontendDist) ---

      - name: Build desktop frontend
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api-client build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk-core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk build
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite build
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      # --- Build debug binary ---

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Build debug binary
        run: cargo build -p cipherbox-desktop --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fuse-feature }}
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Fix rpath for FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }} || true

      # --- Install backend services ---

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install kubo
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_linux-amd64.tar.gz" | tar -xz
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 \
            "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_windows-amd64.zip" \
            -o kubo.zip
          unzip -q kubo.zip
          echo "$PWD/kubo" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$PWD/kubo:$PATH"
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install memurai-developer -y --no-progress
          # Memurai installs as a Windows service and starts automatically
          $svc = Get-Service -Name "Memurai" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          if ($svc -and $svc.Status -eq "Running") {
            Write-Host "Memurai service is running"
          } else {
            # Fallback: start service manually
            Start-Service -Name "Memurai" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
          }
          # Verify Redis is responding
          $env:PATH = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "Machine") + ";" + $env:PATH
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 10; $i++) {
            try {
              $result = & redis-cli ping 2>$null
              if ($result -eq "PONG") { $ready = $true; break }
            } catch {}
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
          }
          if ($ready) { Write-Host "Redis (Memurai) ready" } else { Write-Host "WARNING: Redis may not be ready" }

      # --- Build backend packages ---

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build API
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=desktop-e2e-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:1420
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Create desktop .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF

      # --- Database + API startup ---

      - name: Run migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

      - name: Start API server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: desktop-e2e-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:1420
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Start API server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: desktop-e2e-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:1420
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      # --- Desktop launch + test execution ---

      - name: Start frontend dev server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite preview --port 1420 &
          # Wait for dev server
          for i in $(seq 1 15); do
            if curl -sf http://localhost:1420 > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Frontend dev server ready on :1420"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          export RUST_LOG=info
          BINARY=target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY > /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/desktop-e2e/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$TEST_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
            cat /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          fi
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          diskutil unmount force $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        env:
          CIPHERBOX_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          RUST_LOG: info
          DISPLAY: ':99'
          WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER: '1'
        run: |
          Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1024x768x24 &
          sleep 1
          BINARY=target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY > /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/desktop-e2e/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$TEST_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
            cat /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          fi
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          fusermount3 -u $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Start frontend dev server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd apps/desktop
          npx vite preview --port 1420 &
          for i in $(seq 1 15); do
            if curl -sf http://localhost:1420 > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Frontend dev server ready on :1420"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          BINARY="target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          LOGFILE="$RUNNER_TEMP/cipherbox-desktop.log"
          export DESKTOP_LOG="$LOGFILE"
          "$BINARY" --dev-key "$DEV_KEY" > "$LOGFILE" 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          powershell -File "$PWD/tests/desktop-e2e/scripts/run-all.ps1"
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
          cat "$LOGFILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT
        env:
          CIPHERBOX_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          RUST_LOG: info

      # --- Failure artifacts ---

      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: desktop-e2e-logs-${{ matrix.platform }}

name: Web E2E Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: 'Git ref to checkout (tag, branch, or SHA)'
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  web-e2e:
    name: Web E2E Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15

    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.40.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s

      redis:
        image: redis:7-alpine
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Configure Kubo CORS for browser-based recovery test
        run: |
          # Allow browser cross-origin requests to Kubo gateway (needed by recovery.html)
          docker exec $(docker ps -q --filter ancestor=ipfs/kubo:v0.40.0) ipfs config --json API.HTTPHeaders.Access-Control-Allow-Origin '["*"]'
          docker exec $(docker ps -q --filter ancestor=ipfs/kubo:v0.40.0) ipfs config --json API.HTTPHeaders.Access-Control-Allow-Methods '["GET","POST","OPTIONS"]'
          docker exec $(docker ps -q --filter ancestor=ipfs/kubo:v0.40.0) ipfs config --json Gateway.HTTPHeaders.Access-Control-Allow-Origin '["*"]'
          docker exec $(docker ps -q --filter ancestor=ipfs/kubo:v0.40.0) ipfs config --json Gateway.HTTPHeaders.Access-Control-Allow-Methods '["GET","POST","OPTIONS"]'
          # Restart Kubo to apply config (kill + Docker auto-restarts)
          docker restart $(docker ps -q --filter ancestor=ipfs/kubo:v0.40.0)
          # Wait for Kubo to be healthy again
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if docker exec $(docker ps -q --filter ancestor=ipfs/kubo:v0.40.0) ipfs id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Kubo ready with CORS configured"
              break
            fi
            sleep 2
          done

      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/web-e2e exec playwright install chromium --with-deps

      - name: Install mock-ipns-routing dependencies
        run: |
          cd tools/mock-ipns-routing
          npm install
          npm run build

      - name: Build packages (excluding desktop)
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api-client build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk-core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/web build
        env:
          VITE_WEB3AUTH_CLIENT_ID: ${{ vars.VITE_WEB3AUTH_CLIENT_ID }}
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000

      - name: Create .env files for Web E2E
        run: |
          # Web app .env (for Vite dev server)
          echo "VITE_WEB3AUTH_CLIENT_ID=${{ vars.VITE_WEB3AUTH_CLIENT_ID }}" > apps/web/.env
          echo "VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000" >> apps/web/.env
          # API .env (for NestJS)
          echo "NODE_ENV=test" > apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_HOST=localhost" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_PORT=5432" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_USERNAME=postgres" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_PASSWORD=postgres" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "JWT_SECRET=e2e-test-jwt-secret-key-for-ci" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "IPFS_PROVIDER=local" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "REDIS_HOST=localhost" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "REDIS_PORT=6379" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Run Web E2E tests
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/web-e2e test
        env:
          CI: true
          # Database configuration
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          # IPFS configuration
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          # API configuration
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-test-jwt-secret-key-for-ci
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173
          # IPNS delegated routing (mock service)
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          # Redis for BullMQ job scheduling
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          # Web app configuration (needed for Web3Auth initialization)
          VITE_WEB3AUTH_CLIENT_ID: ${{ vars.VITE_WEB3AUTH_CLIENT_ID }}
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          # Test-login endpoint (bypasses Core Kit, uses deterministic keypair)
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          SDK_E2E_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          # Web3Auth test credentials (fallback if TEST_LOGIN_SECRET not set)
          WEB3AUTH_TEST_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.WEB3AUTH_TEST_EMAIL }}
          WEB3AUTH_TEST_OTP: ${{ secrets.WEB3AUTH_TEST_OTP }}

      - name: Upload Playwright report on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: |
            tests/web-e2e/playwright-report/
            tests/web-e2e/test-results/
          retention-days: 7

  retrigger-release-gate:
    name: Re-trigger Release Gate
    needs: web-e2e
    if: always() && github.event_name == 'push'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: write
      pull-requests: read
    steps:
      - name: Re-run release gate on open release-please PR
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Find any open release-please PR
          PR_BRANCH=$(gh pr list --repo "${{ github.repository }}" \
            --search "head:release-please" --state open --limit 1 \
            --json headRefName --jq '.[0].headRefName // empty')

          if [ -z "$PR_BRANCH" ]; then
            echo "No open release-please PR — nothing to re-trigger"
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "Found open release-please PR on branch: ${PR_BRANCH}"

          # Find the most recent completed release gate run for this branch
          RUN_ID=$(gh run list --repo "${{ github.repository }}" \
            --workflow=release-gate.yml --branch="${PR_BRANCH}" \
            --limit 20 --json databaseId,status \
            --jq 'map(select(.status == "completed")) | .[0].databaseId // empty')

          if [ -z "$RUN_ID" ]; then
            echo "No completed release gate run found for ${PR_BRANCH} — nothing to re-trigger"
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "Re-running release gate (run ${RUN_ID}) so it verifies E2E against current main"
          gh run rerun "${RUN_ID}" --repo "${{ github.repository }}"

              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'crates/**'
              - 'Cargo.toml'
              - 'Cargo.lock'
              - 'tests/vectors/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/desktop-e2e.yml'

  desktop-e2e:
    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})
    needs: [changes]
    if: >-
      always() && !cancelled() &&
      (
        github.event_name != 'push' ||
        needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
      )
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: macos
            os: macos-latest
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop.exe
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}

      # --- Install FUSE driver (needed for both build and test) ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install system dependencies (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential
          sudo modprobe fuse || true

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow
          # Verify WinFsp installed and add bin to PATH for DLL discovery
          $winfspDir = (Get-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\WinFsp" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).InstallDir
          if ($winfspDir) {
            Write-Host "WinFsp installed at: $winfspDir"
            $binDir = Join-Path $winfspDir "bin"
            Write-Host "Adding to PATH: $binDir"
            echo "$binDir" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Encoding utf8 -Append
          } else {
            Write-Host "WARNING: WinFsp registry key not found after install"
          }

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm (needed for frontend build before cargo) ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # --- Build desktop frontend (Tauri embeds from frontendDist) ---

      - name: Build desktop frontend
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api-client build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk-core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk build
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite build
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      # --- Build debug binary ---

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Build debug binary
        run: cargo build -p cipherbox-desktop --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fuse-feature }}
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Fix rpath for FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }} || true

      # --- Install backend services ---

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install kubo
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_linux-amd64.tar.gz" | tar -xz
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 \
            "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_windows-amd64.zip" \
            -o kubo.zip
          unzip -q kubo.zip
          echo "$PWD/kubo" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$PWD/kubo:$PATH"
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install memurai-developer -y --no-progress
          # Memurai installs as a Windows service and starts automatically
          $svc = Get-Service -Name "Memurai" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          if ($svc -and $svc.Status -eq "Running") {
            Write-Host "Memurai service is running"
          } else {
            # Fallback: start service manually
            Start-Service -Name "Memurai" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
          }
          # Verify Redis is responding
          $env:PATH = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "Machine") + ";" + $env:PATH
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 10; $i++) {
            try {
              $result = & redis-cli ping 2>$null
              if ($result -eq "PONG") { $ready = $true; break }
            } catch {}
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
          }
          if ($ready) { Write-Host "Redis (Memurai) ready" } else { Write-Host "WARNING: Redis may not be ready" }

      # --- Build backend packages ---

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build API
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=desktop-e2e-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:1420
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Create desktop .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF

      # --- Database + API startup ---

      - name: Run migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

      - name: Start API server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: desktop-e2e-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:1420
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Start API server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: desktop-e2e-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:1420
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      # --- Desktop launch + test execution ---

      - name: Start frontend dev server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite preview --port 1420 &
          # Wait for dev server
          for i in $(seq 1 15); do
            if curl -sf http://localhost:1420 > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Frontend dev server ready on :1420"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          export RUST_LOG=info
          BINARY=target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY > /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/desktop-e2e/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$TEST_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
            cat /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          fi
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          diskutil unmount force $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        env:
          CIPHERBOX_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          RUST_LOG: info
          DISPLAY: ':99'
          WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER: '1'
        run: |
          Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1024x768x24 &
          sleep 1
          BINARY=target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY > /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/desktop-e2e/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$TEST_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
            cat /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          fi
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          fusermount3 -u $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Start frontend dev server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd apps/desktop
          npx vite preview --port 1420 &
          for i in $(seq 1 15); do
            if curl -sf http://localhost:1420 > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Frontend dev server ready on :1420"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          BINARY="target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          LOGFILE="$RUNNER_TEMP/cipherbox-desktop.log"
          export DESKTOP_LOG="$LOGFILE"
          "$BINARY" --dev-key "$DEV_KEY" > "$LOGFILE" 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          powershell -File "$PWD/tests/desktop-e2e/scripts/run-all.ps1"
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
          cat "$LOGFILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT
        env:
          CIPHERBOX_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          RUST_LOG: info

      # --- Failure artifacts ---

      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: desktop-e2e-logs-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: |
            apps/api/*.log
            ~/Library/Logs/fuse-t/fuse-t.log
            /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/cipherbox-desktop.log
          retention-days: 7

            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install system dependencies (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential
          sudo modprobe fuse || true

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow
          # Verify WinFsp installed and add bin to PATH for DLL discovery
          $winfspDir = (Get-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\WinFsp" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).InstallDir
          if ($winfspDir) {
            Write-Host "WinFsp installed at: $winfspDir"
            $binDir = Join-Path $winfspDir "bin"
            Write-Host "Adding to PATH: $binDir"
            echo "$binDir" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Encoding utf8 -Append
          } else {
            Write-Host "WARNING: WinFsp registry key not found after install"
          }

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm (needed for frontend build before cargo) ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # --- Build desktop frontend (Tauri embeds from frontendDist) ---

      - name: Build desktop frontend
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api-client build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk-core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk build
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite build
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      # --- Build debug binary ---

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Build debug binary
        run: cargo build -p cipherbox-desktop --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fuse-feature }}
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Fix rpath for FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }} || true

      # --- Install backend services ---

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install kubo
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_linux-amd64.tar.gz" | tar -xz
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 \
            "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_windows-amd64.zip" \
            -o kubo.zip
          unzip -q kubo.zip
          echo "$PWD/kubo" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$PWD/kubo:$PATH"
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install memurai-developer -y --no-progress
          # Memurai installs as a Windows service and starts automatically
          $svc = Get-Service -Name "Memurai" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          if ($svc -and $svc.Status -eq "Running") {
            Write-Host "Memurai service is running"
          } else {
            # Fallback: start service manually
            Start-Service -Name "Memurai" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
          }
          # Verify Redis is responding
          $env:PATH = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "Machine") + ";" + $env:PATH
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 10; $i++) {
            try {
              $result = & redis-cli ping 2>$null
              if ($result -eq "PONG") { $ready = $true; break }
            } catch {}
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
          }
          if ($ready) { Write-Host "Redis (Memurai) ready" } else { Write-Host "WARNING: Redis may not be ready" }

      # --- Build backend packages ---

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build API
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=desktop-e2e-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:1420
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Create desktop .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF

      # --- Database + API startup ---

      - name: Run migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

      - name: Start API server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'

          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness

          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: desktop-e2e-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:1420
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Start API server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"

              break

          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY > /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/desktop-e2e/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?

          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Start frontend dev server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd apps/desktop
          npx vite preview --port 1420 &
          for i in $(seq 1 15); do
            if curl -sf http://localhost:1420 > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Frontend dev server ready on :1420"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          BINARY="target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          LOGFILE="$RUNNER_TEMP/cipherbox-desktop.log"
          export DESKTOP_LOG="$LOGFILE"
          "$BINARY" --dev-key "$DEV_KEY" > "$LOGFILE" 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          powershell -File "$PWD/tests/desktop-e2e/scripts/run-all.ps1"
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
          cat "$LOGFILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT
        env:
          CIPHERBOX_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          RUST_LOG: info

      # --- Failure artifacts ---

      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: desktop-e2e-logs-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: |
            apps/api/*.log
            ~/Library/Logs/fuse-t/fuse-t.log
            /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/cipherbox-desktop.log
          retention-days: 7

name: Release Gate

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  detect-changes:
    name: Detect Changes Since Last Release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.check.outputs.desktop || steps.release-check.outputs.desktop }}
      prev_tag: ${{ steps.check.outputs.prev_tag || steps.release-check.outputs.prev_tag }}
      is_release: ${{ steps.release-check.outputs.is_release }}
    steps:
      - name: Check if release PR
        id: release-check
        env:
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.head_ref }}
        run: |
          if [[ "$HEAD_REF" == release-please--* ]]; then
            echo "is_release=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "is_release=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "desktop=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "prev_tag=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Not a release PR — skipping change detection"
          fi

            echo "::error::Most recent Desktop E2E run in range (at ${LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA}) did not succeed (conclusion: ${LATEST_IN_RANGE_CONCLUSION})."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Desktop E2E: passed (run ${LATEST_IN_RANGE_RUN_ID} at ${LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA} with tests executed)"

        if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--') && needs.detect-changes.outputs.desktop != 'true'
        run: echo "No desktop-related changes since last release — skipping Desktop E2E gate"

      - name: Summary
        if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--')
        run: echo "All E2E gates passed — release is safe to merge."

if [ -z "$RECENT_RUN_ID" ]; then
              echo "::error::No recent CI E2E run found where Web E2E tests actually executed."
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "Web E2E: passed (in CI E2E run ${RECENT_RUN_ID})"
          else
            echo "Web E2E: passed (at HEAD)"
          fi

      - name: Verify Desktop E2E (if desktop changed)
        if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--') && needs.detect-changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PREV_TAG: ${{ needs.detect-changes.outputs.prev_tag }}
        run: |
          MAIN_SHA=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/git/ref/heads/main --jq '.object.sha')
          echo "Desktop changes detected since ${PREV_TAG} — verifying Desktop E2E"

          # Helper: check if a workflow run actually executed desktop-e2e jobs
          # (not skipped due to change detection). Returns 0 if tests ran, 1 if skipped, 2 on API error.
          run_executed_tests() {
            local run_id=$1
            local executed
            if ! executed=$(gh api "repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${run_id}/jobs" \
              --jq '[.jobs[] | select(.name | startswith("Desktop E2E")) | select(.conclusion == "success")] | length'); then
              echo "::error::Failed to query jobs for run ${run_id} (API error or rate limit)"
              return 2
            fi
            [ "${executed:-0}" -gt 0 ]
          }

          # First check if there's a desktop E2E run for HEAD (may still be running)
          HEAD_RUN=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
            --workflow=desktop-e2e.yml --branch=main --limit=50 \
            --json headSha,conclusion,status,databaseId \
            --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0]")

          HEAD_STATUS=$(echo "$HEAD_RUN" | jq -r '.status // empty')

          if [ -n "$HEAD_STATUS" ]; then
            HEAD_RUN_ID=$(echo "$HEAD_RUN" | jq -r '.databaseId')
            echo "Desktop E2E run exists for HEAD (run ${HEAD_RUN_ID}) — polling until complete..."
            MAX_ATTEMPTS=40
            POLL_INTERVAL=30

            for attempt in $(seq 1 $MAX_ATTEMPTS); do
              CONCLUSION=$(gh run view "$HEAD_RUN_ID" --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
                --json conclusion \
                --jq '.conclusion // empty')

              if [ -n "$CONCLUSION" ]; then
                if [ "$CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
                  echo "::error::Desktop E2E Tests did not pass on main (conclusion: ${CONCLUSION})"
                  exit 1
                fi
                # Verify the desktop-e2e jobs actually ran (not skipped)
                run_executed_tests "$HEAD_RUN_ID" && rc=0 || rc=$?
                if [ "$rc" -eq 2 ]; then
                  exit 1
                elif [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
                  echo "Desktop E2E: passed (at HEAD, tests executed)"
                  exit 0
                else
                  echo "Desktop E2E run at HEAD succeeded but tests were skipped (no desktop changes detected by workflow)."
                  echo "Falling through to search for a run that actually executed tests..."
                  break
                fi
              fi

              if [ "$attempt" -eq "$MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then
                echo "::error::Desktop E2E run did not complete within $(( MAX_ATTEMPTS * POLL_INTERVAL / 60 )) minutes."
                exit 1
              fi

              echo "Attempt ${attempt}/${MAX_ATTEMPTS}: Desktop E2E still running, waiting ${POLL_INTERVAL}s..."
              sleep $POLL_INTERVAL
            done
          fi

          # No desktop E2E run for HEAD (or HEAD run skipped tests) — find the
          # most recent run in the release range that actually executed tests
          echo "Searching for a Desktop E2E run that executed tests since ${PREV_TAG}..."

          if [ -z "$PREV_TAG" ]; then
            echo "::error::No previous release tag and no Desktop E2E run for HEAD. Cannot verify desktop changes."
            exit 1
          fi

          # Get commit SHAs in the release range
          RANGE_COMMITS=$(gh api "repos/${{ github.repository }}/compare/${PREV_TAG}...${MAIN_SHA}" \
            --jq '[.commits[].sha] | join("\n")' 2>/dev/null || echo "")

          if [ -z "$RANGE_COMMITS" ]; then
            echo "::error::Could not determine commits in range ${PREV_TAG}..${MAIN_SHA}"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Get recent completed desktop E2E runs (newest first) and find the
          # most recent one whose commit is within the release range AND whose
          # desktop-e2e jobs actually ran (not skipped)
          RUNS=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
            --workflow=desktop-e2e.yml --branch=main --limit=50 \
            --json headSha,conclusion,status,databaseId \
            --jq '.[] | select(.status == "completed") | "\(.headSha) \(.conclusion) \(.databaseId)"')

          LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA=""
          LATEST_IN_RANGE_CONCLUSION=""

          while IFS=" " read -r sha conclusion run_id; do
            if [ -z "$sha" ]; then
              continue
            fi
            if echo "$RANGE_COMMITS" | grep -Fq "$sha"; then
              if [ "$conclusion" != "success" ]; then
                # Found a failed run in range — report it immediately
                LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA="$sha"
                LATEST_IN_RANGE_CONCLUSION="$conclusion"
                break
              fi
              # Success run — verify tests actually executed
              run_executed_tests "$run_id" && rc=0 || rc=$?
              if [ "$rc" -eq 2 ]; then
                exit 1
              elif [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
                LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA="$sha"
                LATEST_IN_RANGE_CONCLUSION="$conclusion"
                LATEST_IN_RANGE_RUN_ID="$run_id"
                break
              else
                echo "Skipping run ${run_id} at ${sha} — tests were skipped (no desktop changes detected by workflow)"
              fi
            fi
          done <<EOF
          $RUNS
          EOF

          if [ -z "$LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA" ]; then
            echo "::error::No Desktop E2E run found (with tests actually executed) for any commit in ${PREV_TAG}..HEAD. Desktop code changed but was never verified."
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ "$LATEST_IN_RANGE_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::Most recent Desktop E2E run in range (at ${LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA}) did not succeed (conclusion: ${LATEST_IN_RANGE_CONCLUSION})."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Desktop E2E: passed (run ${LATEST_IN_RANGE_RUN_ID} at ${LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA} with tests executed)"

      - name: Skip Desktop E2E (no desktop changes)
        if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--') && needs.detect-changes.outputs.desktop != 'true'
        run: echo "No desktop-related changes since last release — skipping Desktop E2E gate"

      - name: Summary
        if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--')
        run: echo "All E2E gates passed — release is safe to merge."
